source.disclaimer: Third-party PBE/GPAW-relaxed monolayer from the C2DB; NOT the author-relaxed structure of Zhu et al. PRL 135, 056801 (2025).
source.conversion_algorithm: scripts/export_c2db_monolayer.py: reads the local C2DB row dump (project-cy/c2db.db, system id 4195, UID 2AgF2-1; input path configurable via env AGF2_C2DB_ROW_JSON, default /tmp/agf2_2AgF2-1_structure.json; numbers, 3x3 row-major cell, flat Cartesian positions); asserts composition Ag2F4 and an orthorhombic cell (a,b in-plane, z = vacuum slab height); reorders atoms into VASP species blocks [Ag, F]; writes Cartesian POSCAR (8 dp) and a visualization CIF (P1, no symmetry applied); hashes POSCAR, CIF and the raw database-row dump. Cell vectors and positions are copied verbatim from the database row - nothing is fabricated or symmetrized.
source.original_row_verification: source_row_uid_sha256 = SHA-256 of the raw JSON dump of the database row (system 4195); cross-checked against the 2022-11-30 dump (system 10217, same cell, E=-19.3594 eV)
source.retrieval_route: independent retrieval: https://cmr.fysik.dtu.dk/c2db/ (search UID 2AgF2-1) or the registry C2DB_all_data.csv row 4194
